description.zh: 算力类别。取值为economy时，表示查询经济型规格的价格。
description.en: The category of computing power. Set the value to \`economy\` to query the price of an economy instance type.

description.zh: vCPU大小。ECI支持的vCPU和内存规格请参见[vCPU和内存规格说明](~~114662~~)。
description.en: The number of vCPUs. For more information about the vCPU and memory specifications that are supported by ECI, see [vCPU and memory specifications](~~114662~~).

description.zh: 临时存储空间大小。单位为GiB.。
description.en: The size of the temporary storage space. Unit: GiB.

description.zh:
指定的ECS实例规格。ECI支持指定的ECS规格请参见[ECI支持的ECS规格说明](~~114664~~)。

> 设置该参数后，将自动忽略传入的vCPU和内存值，仅返回ECS规格的价格信息。
description.en:
The ECS instance type. For more information about the ECS instance types that are supported by ECI, see [ECS instance types supported by ECI](~~114664~~).

> If you set this parameter, the specified values for the Cpu and Memory parameters are ignored. The price of only the ECS instance type is returned.

description.zh: 内存大小。单位为GiB。ECI支持的vCPU和内存规格请参见[vCPU和内存规格说明](~~114662~~)。
description.en: The memory size. Unit: GiB. For more information about the vCPU and memory specifications that are supported by ECI, see [vCPU and memory specifications](~~114662~~).

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~146965~~)查询最新的地域可用区信息。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~146965~~) to query the latest information about regions and zones.

description.zh: 抢占式实例的保护期。单位为小时。默认为1。可设置为0，表示无保护期。
description.en: The protection period of the spot instance. Unit: hour. Default value: 1. A value of 0 indicates that no protection period is specified.

description.zh: 设置抢占式实例的每小时最高价格，最多精确到小数点后3位。当SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时，必须设置SpotPriceLimit。
description.en: The maximum hourly price of the spot instance. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. This parameter is required when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

description.zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

- NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。

默认为：NoSpot。
description.en:
The preemption policy for the instance. Valid values:

- NoSpot: a regular pay-as-you-go instance.

- SpotWithPriceLimit: a spot instance for which you specify the maximum hourly price.

- SpotAsPriceGo: a spot instance for which the system automatically bids based on the current market price.

Default value: NoSpot.

description.zh: 可用区。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~146965~~)查询最新的地域可用区信息。
description.en: The zone ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~146965~~) to query the latest information about regions and zones.

descriptions.zh:
- 本接口不支持资源组鉴权。
- ECI实例支持指定vCPU和内存，或者指定ECS规格创建。调用本接口查询价格时，请传入ECI支持指定的规格。
    - [vCPU和内存规格说明](~~114662~~)。
    - [ECI支持的ECS规格说明](~~114664~~)。
descriptions.en:
- This operation does not support resource group-based authentication.

- You can create an ECI instance by specifying the number of vCPUs and memory size, or by specifying an ECS instance type. When you call this operation to query prices, specify the supported specifications.

  - For more information, see [vCPU and memory specifications](~~114662~~).

  - For more information, see [ECS instance types supported by ECI](~~114664~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eci describe-container-group-price --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cpu 2.0 --memory 4.0 --instance-type ecs.c5.large --spot-strategy SpotWithPriceLimit --zone-id cn-hangzhou-g --spot-price-limit 0.2 --ephemeral-storage 20 --spot-duration 1 --compute-category economy --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eci DescribeContainerGroupPrice --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-g' --Memory '4.0' --ComputeCategory economy --Cpu '2.0' --SpotPriceLimit '0.2' --SpotDuration 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType 'ecs.c5.large' --EphemeralStorage 20 --SpotStrategy SpotWithPriceLimit
